items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: Kendall and Joe got a job.

ctx.x: Did they get tips much in the district? Oh, yes. Oh, yes.

Oh, yes. They got tips. And the tips was all made, put in a box. Yes. And it was each out of one to the other. Every man would get so much. Whenever they got, every man would get it. But then he played down there for a long, long time. And after he played down there, he had a little band playing at a stable, they call it, on Padre Street. Used to play around there. Well... At a stable? It was a dance hall. That they fixed up for the... For the... To dance. To dance, yes. To dance. And they raided them one night.…
Sidney I believe what their name was. Yes. It was one of the boats. I think the St. Paul sometime around there. Yes. Sidney though I believe was the main one they worked on first.
